stages.journal: Skarn held the pay-tin a long time before he spoke. The count can be closed now, he says, but closed properly — cut in stone, where the seal used to stand. Mistress Petra broke that seal with her own hands; she keeps the mason's yard on Silverfall's crafting terrace. She'll cut the names, if it's Skarn asking. Go and ask for him.

Petra didn't argue. She asked for the mark, measured it with her thumb, and said the stone would be ready before the names were cold. One thing left: a flame for the dead. Sella keeps the Silver Shrine above the mere — the mother-flame every road lamp is lit from. Ask her to set a light for the crew. Then bring Skarn word that it's done.
